answer: A farm-agent exchange could tie each subsidized sensor report to a registered land parcel and time window. Ten bots reporting yarrow in the same meadow share one reward ceiling, however many names appear on the horizon. The ledger rejects duplicate parcel-window claims using signed survey records. To scale a sybil farm, an attacker must control more verified land or bribe the surveyor. This curbs alias-based subsidies, but forged boundaries and exclusion of tenants remain real limitations.
